objective: Create the Style 9 golden cover as a condensed mechanism-poster explaining how one generic request is handled reliably by a high-concurrency service.

confirmed: The visual subject is a generic high-concurrency service request-processing mechanism.
The four supported responsibility zones are traffic intake, task scheduling, service execution, and exception protection.
Rate limiting, isolation, caching, and degradation are presented only as distinct generic capabilities without performance guarantees.
simplifications: Represent the service as one central request-processing core rather than a vendor-specific deployment.
Use one compact technical icon per supported zone and keep the cover approximately thirty percent less dense than a body infographic.
blocked: Do not add vendor names, product logos, protocols, benchmark values, latency numbers, throughput numbers, guarantees, databases, queues, user figures, robots, or extra processing stages.
Do not copy the titles, topology, icons, node count, or layout from any temporary user reference.
